children: IQVIA entered into an Indenture as its subsidiary issued $2.0 billion of 6.375% senior unsecured notes due 2034. Interest is payable semi-annually on March 15 and September 15, beginning March 15, 2027. Net proceeds will redeem the 5.000% 2026 notes in full, repay a portion of borrowings under the revolving credit facility, and cover fees and expenses. The notes are callable with a make-whole before September 15, 2029, and thereafter at premiums stepping down to par.
: Indenture for 6.375% senior unsecured notes due 2034
: U.S. Bank Trust, as trustee, and certain subsidiary guarantors
: Refinance 2026 notes and reduce revolver borrowings
